titulo: Reduced Relatives, Participle Clauses and Nominalisation
descripcion: At C2 this compression is calibrated to genre: a legal or scientific register tolerates near-total nominalisation, while even sophisticated journalism keeps a verbal backbone. The C1 skill was producing the compression correctly; C2 is judging how much a given text can bear.

cuadroReferencia.titulo: How much compression a genre bears
filas: The party having failed to comply, termination follows.
Samples collected in situ were analysed off-site.
Having lost the vote, the minister resigned the next day.

ejemplos.texto: The party having failed to comply, termination follows automatically.
Having lost the vote decisively, the minister resigned the following day.
Exhausted, she said nothing for the rest of the journey.

notas: An absolute construction (the party having failed…) is essentially confined to legal and highly formal registers; using it in ordinary prose reads as an affectation.
The same participle clause that sounds efficient in a report can sound cold in narrative, where a fuller clause carries more feeling.
Judging the ceiling of compression a text can bear is itself the C2 skill — the individual constructions were already available at C1.

contraste.es: El español tolera mucha menos compresión nominal en cualquier género, así que un texto legal o científico en español sigue pareciendo más verbal que su equivalente inglés. Un hispanohablante de C2 tiende a subestimar cuánta compresión el inglés espera en un registro legal o técnico, y a sobreestimarla en la narrativa.

errores: Using an absolute construction outside legal or highly formal writing, where it reads as pretentious.
Under-compressing a legal or scientific text relative to what the genre expects.
Over-compressing literary narrative, which drains it of feeling.
autochequeo: Does the level of compression match the genre's actual tolerance, not just what's grammatically possible?
Is an absolute construction reserved for legal or very formal contexts?
Does literary narrative keep enough verbal texture to carry feeling?
Would an expert reader of this genre find the density normal, not either sparse or overwrought?
Have I identified the genre before judging the density?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the level of nominal and participial compression matches the genre. Flag any absolute construction outside legal or very formal writing. Do not rewrite the text.
